styles.name: Defensive
styles.description: Survives through Guard, damage reduction, barriers, and protection effects.

focuses.name: Bulwark
focuses.description: Pure survival: Protective Shell and barrier effects scale at levels 10, 25, and 40.

focuses.name: Counterguard
focuses.description: Retaliation guard: after taking damage, your next active damage effect is empowered more strongly at levels 25 and 40.

focuses.name: Commander
focuses.description: Protective command: owned summons gain stronger durability and build more Guard when struck as the style levels.

styles.coreMechanic: Gain Guard when taking damage. At 100 Guard, gain Protective Shell.

styles.name: Fighter
styles.description: Builds Momentum through direct damage and converts it into empowered strikes.

focuses.name: Duelist
focuses.description: Reliable precision: active single-target damage effects scale upward at levels 10, 25, and 40.

focuses.name: Berserker
focuses.description: Risk pressure: active damage is empowered while wounded, scaling higher at levels 25 and 40.

focuses.name: Vanguard
focuses.description: Durable pressure: direct damage reduction and Momentum gained when hit scale at levels 10, 25, and 40.

styles.coreMechanic: Gain Momentum from direct damage. At 100 Momentum, empower the next direct damage active effect.

styles.name: Caster
styles.description: Builds Arcane Charge through active Essence use and amplifies magic-adjacent effects.

focuses.name: Arcanist
focuses.description: Pure arcana: active Magic and Spell effects scale higher and build extra Arcane Charge at later milestones.

focuses.name: Spellblade
focuses.description: Adds Spirit-scaling arcane damage to Melee active effects, improving at levels 25 and 40.

focuses.name: Occultist
focuses.description: Dark study: Curse and damage-over-time active effects scale higher and build extra Arcane Charge.

styles.coreMechanic: Gain Arcane Charge from active Essence abilities. At 5 Charge, empower the next eligible active effect.

styles.name: Summoner
styles.description: Builds Command through summon-tagged actions and improves summon effects without creating summons by itself.

focuses.name: Horde
focuses.description: Many allies: owned summons gain offensive power that scales at levels 10, 25, and 40.

focuses.name: Champion
focuses.description: One strong ally: owned summons gain maximum health that scales at levels 10, 25, and 40.

focuses.name: Ritualist
focuses.description: Sacred or profane rites: Curse/Holy summon effects gain stronger amplification at later milestones.

styles.coreMechanic: Gain Command from Summon-tagged active abilities. At 100 Command, empower the next Summon-tagged effect.

styles.name: Swift
styles.description: Builds Flow through quick active Essence use and rewards evasive, mobile pressure.

focuses.name: Flurry
focuses.description: Rapid pressure: active Melee and Ranged damage scale at levels 10, 25, and 40.

focuses.name: Evasion
focuses.description: Survival through movement: incoming direct damage reduction scales at levels 10, 25, and 40.

focuses.name: Tempo
focuses.description: Rhythm play: active effects gain extra Flow and stronger Flow empowerment at later milestones.

styles.coreMechanic: Gain Flow from active Essence abilities. At 100 Flow, empower the next active effect.

styles.name: Marksman
styles.description: Builds Aim through ranged direct damage and rewards precision, marks, and tactical shots.

focuses.name: Sniper
focuses.description: Single-target precision: ranged single-target damage scales at levels 10, 25, and 40.

focuses.name: Volley
focuses.description: Multi-target fire: ranged multi-target damage scales at levels 10, 25, and 40.

focuses.name: Trapper
focuses.description: Marks and setup: ranged status and debuff effects build more Aim and scale at milestones.

styles.coreMechanic: Gain Aim from ranged direct damage. At 100 Aim, empower the next ranged damage effect.

styles.name: Support
styles.description: Builds Resolve through healing, barriers, and ally protection effects.

focuses.name: Healer
focuses.description: Restoration focus: healing effects scale at levels 10, 25, and 40.

focuses.name: Warden
focuses.description: Protection focus: barrier effects and ally protection scale at levels 10, 25, and 40.

focuses.name: Chaplain
focuses.description: Holy hybrid support: Holy healing, barriers, and damage scale at milestones.

styles.coreMechanic: Gain Resolve from healing and barrier effects. At 100 Resolve, empower the next heal or barrier.

styles.name: Controller
styles.description: Builds Control through status, debuff, and disruption effects.

focuses.name: Hexer
focuses.description: Curse and attrition: Curse/DoT effects scale at levels 10, 25, and 40.

focuses.name: Tactician
focuses.description: Debuff setup: debuffs and tactical damage windows scale at milestones.

focuses.name: Frostbinder
focuses.description: Hard control: control-tagged statuses and follow-up damage scale at milestones.

styles.coreMechanic: Gain Control from active status and debuff effects. At 100 Control, empower the next control, debuff, curse, or damage-over-time effect.
